title: Darcy–Weisbach single pipe
description: Steady flow through a 1 km, 300 mm pipe at 1 m/s. The friction factor follows from Colebrook–White, so the exact head loss Δh = f (L/D) V²/(2g) = 3.09 m checks both the friction law a solver uses and how it applies it.

citations.title: Classical Darcy–Weisbach pipe-friction relation (as used in EPANET hydraulics)

criteria.rationale: Exact Colebrook–White head loss within 1 %: the accuracy Swamee & Jain (1976) give for their explicit approximation over 5e3 < Re < 1e8, so a solver using any standard explicit friction formula passes and a wrong friction law or a units error fails.
Heads along the pipe within 5 cm of the linear exact profile: catches a correct total loss distributed wrongly.

convergence.not_applicable: Steady closed-form pipe flow: a network solver has no grid to refine, so observed order of accuracy does not apply.
